decks.notes: The following deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures such as Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent while utilizing efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. The deck also includes a mix of counter spells like Counterspell, Spell Snare, and Spell Pierce to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Card draw and manipulation with Preordain, Mishra's Bauble, and Expressive Iteration help to maintain consistency and find key pieces. The deck aims to close out games swiftly and efficiently through a combination of creature pressure and burn spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mixture of removal, disruption, and powerful creatures. The key concept revolves around utilizing the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring, which allows for additional mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells. The deck includes a combination of versatile removal spells such as Go for the Throat and Fatal Push, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize. The creature lineup consists of efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Grist, the Hunger Tide, supported by ramp cards like Springleaf Drum and Elvish Reclaimer. The land base is optimized for consistent mana sources while also including utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Urza's Saga.

The deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Ardent Plea to cascade into powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Subtlety, the deck aims to control the board while consistently putting pressure on the opponent. Force of Negation and Leyline Binding provide additional disruptive elements to protect and enhance the aggressive strategy. The mana base is crafted to support the deck's color requirements and maximize the potential for explosive cascade chains.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures and disrupting opponents with removal and hand disruption spells. The key strategy is to control the board early with aggressive creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Orcish Bowmasters, while using Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Life from the Loam and Call of the Death-Dweller for extra value. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and flexibility in casting spells.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Shardless Agent, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield simultaneously. This combo can overwhelm opponents with a sudden influx of creatures while disrupting their hand with cards like Grief and force of negation. The deck also includes creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves to provide additional card advantage and pressure. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and disrupt their game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells like Ardent Plea and Violent Outburst to free cast Crashing Footfalls and generate a swarm of 4/4 Rhino tokens. Shardless Agent is used to cascade into powerful spells while Force of Negation provides protection. Teferi, Time Raveler disrupts opponents' plans and Bonecrusher Giant provides removal and a steady source of damage. Murktide Regent serves as a finisher. The deck also includes versatile spells like Subtlety, Fire / Ice, and Leyline Binding to control the board and secure victory through aggressive play.

This deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while using cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to remove opposing creatures. The deck also includes card draw and selection with expressive iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain consistency. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's aggressive strategy and ensure it can operate smoothly in the early game.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently assemble Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, and Urza's Power Plant - collectively known as UrzaTron - to generate a large amount of mana and play powerful threats such as Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes a number of control elements like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan, as well as powerful planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to provide additional value and win conditions. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides a unique deck building restriction and additional mana acceleration.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly cast cascade spells like Ardent Plea and Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Misty Rainforest to manipulate the top of your library, you have a higher chance of hitting your cascade spells. Leyline Binding and Force of Negation help protect your board while Gemstone Caverns and Xander's Lounge provide additional mana sources. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy while maintaining control of the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, utilizing disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to control the opponent's hand while hitting hard with creatures like Ragavan and Kroxa. The deck also includes burn spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt for removal and direct damage. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect the deck's key creatures and maximize their impact. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain pressure throughout the game, ultimately securing victory through aggressive plays and efficient resource management.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly by playing efficient, aggressive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Fury. It also utilizes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to keep the opponent off balance. The deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive strategy with fast lands and fetch lands. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost spells to quickly flood the board with powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cascade spells like Ardent Plea and Violent Outburst, the deck is able to cheat out expensive creatures like Shardless Agent and Crashing Footfalls for free. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Subtlety to control the game and maintain board presence. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy while utilizing the cascade mechanic to gain an advantage.

This Modern 1 vs 1 deck focuses on utilizing the "Scapeshift" card to quickly assemble the combo of having "Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle" and multiple mountains in play in order to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards like "Wrenn and Six" and "Dryad of the Ilysian Grove" to ensure consistent land drops and ramp, while also running removal in the form of "Lightning Bolt" and additional win conditions like "Primeval Titan". The goal is to control the board while setting up for a game-winning Scapeshift combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that mill the opponent's deck, such as Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Drown in the Loch. The goal is to mill the opponent's entire deck as quickly as possible, using Archive Trap, Fractured Sanity, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter. This strategy aims to win the game by forcing the opponent to draw from an empty library, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut. The deck also includes card draw and land destruction to support the mill plan effectively.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent's life total using a combination of burn spells, creatures, and life drain effects. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total with cards like Lightning Bolt, Bump in the Night, and Soul Spike. It also includes cards like Rakdos Charm and Gonti's Machinations for additional damage and disruption. The creatures in the deck, such as Orcish Bowmasters, Chancellor of the Dross, and Sleeper Agent, offer early aggression and further life loss for the opponent. The mana base includes a mix of black and red sources to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. With this mana, the deck aims to play powerful threats such as Wurmcoil Engine, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Karn Liberated. It also includes various control elements like Dismember, Relic of Progenitus, and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to help find the UrzaTron lands quickly, ensuring a strong late game presence and the ability to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.
